404 Not Found when retrieving a nonexistent batch

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm import Error

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        batch_id = "batch-nonexistent"
        await client.retrieve_batch(batch_id)
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
